name: php_input_exec
description: Runs the raw request body as a shell command, in a .well-known validation directory. Realtime leaves it in place through a detector shortfall: its execution confirmation blanks string literals, so it never sees the php://input source the content check matched.

tier.gap: YARA, PHP taint and content checks miss the raw request body passed to system

fullscan.gap: YARA misses the raw request body passed to system
